title: 第13章 首胜的喜悦第14章 古城凤凰岛
slug: 圣殇天狱第1013章力战古神
content_zh:
美姑，
山风吹得正急，
‘呯’，
云阳被一拳轰退数步，才稳住脚步，
指骨传来撕裂疼痛，眉清目秀的脸庞，嘴角抽了抽，
心里暗道；果然高一级，都是鸿沟，但那有什么，师尊说鸿沟就是逆天的人打破的，
‘天昭金刚拳，无影腿，打’
随即再次发起攻击，
在快速冲刺中一跃而起，
拳头霎那间变成飞腿。
无论怎么变，
桑奎木都不是太在意发起攻击的云阳，
他在心里畏惧那个不远处漂亮的跟瓷娃娃一般的灵汐，
他正是在山路逃窜被灵汐‘咯咯咯’的拦住的去路，
天籁的笑声中，那小魔女抬手一指，
他就被压制，腿脚不能动弹，
直到云阳赶到，
小魔女退到远处，他才恢复自由，
然后不能专心，提心吊胆的和云阳对战，
‘桑刀，斩’

黝黑高大的桑奎木对着飞腿冲来的云阳使出桑家必杀技，
身形刚猛，出手狠毒迅速，
幽暗的刀光带着寒风接连三刀砍向飞腿，
‘砰’，‘噗’，
空气中传来牙痛的身体撞击和快刀破肉的声音，
灵汐在远处皱眉，俏脸扭到一旁；
‘好低级的厮杀，看到肉疼。’
桑奎木被连环腿抽中一腿，尽头牙齿崩碎两颗，
摇摇晃晃的摔坐在地，捂着嘴吐出带血水的碎牙，心里那个恨呀，
从小就在美姑小镇作威作福的他，何时遭受过这样的打击，
一年前，这小子他一根指头都可以戳死，
环眼横瞪那个大腿中了一刀的小和尚，怒从心起；
‘桑刀五斩，滚地刀，小咋种，死，’
从地下一个驴打滚杀向云阳，
云阳在进攻中，挨了一刀，
如今刀口处鲜血正在涌出，
高手的伤害，痛到深处，心里直呼凉气，
但看见刀光快速袭来，顾不得伤痛，单掌撑地一扭；
‘灵燕脱身，回手刀。’
身体以不可想象的灵动在虚空翻转，

掌刀横切桑奎木喉结，
‘噗嗤’，‘啊·啊’
两声惨叫传来，
content_en:
Beautiful aunt,
The mountain wind is blowing hard,
‘Bang’,
Yunyang was knocked back several steps by a punch before he stabilized his steps.
There was tearing pain in the phalanges, and the corners of his mouth twitched on his pretty face.
I thought secretly in my heart: Sure enough, there is a gap at a higher level, but what does that mean? Master said that the gap is broken by people who defy heaven.
‘Tianzhao Vajra Fist, Shadowless Kick, Fight’
Then he attacked again,
Jumping up in a quick sprint,
The fist suddenly turned into a flying kick.
No matter how it changes,
Sang Kuimu didn't pay much attention to Yunyang who launched the attack.
In his heart, he was afraid of the beautiful porcelain doll-like spirit not far away.
He was escaping on the mountain road and was blocked by Ling tide.
Amid the natural laughter, the little witch raised her hand and pointed,
He was suppressed, unable to move his legs and feet.
Until Yunyang arrived,
The little witch retreated far away, and then he regained his freedom.
Then he couldn't concentrate and fought with Yunyang in fear.
‘Sang Dao, cut’
The dark and tall Sang Kuimu used the Sang family's special move against Yunyang who was rushing towards him.
His body is strong and his attacks are vicious and swift.
The dark sword light brought with it the cold wind, and he slashed at Fei Li three times in succession.
‘Bang’, ‘pop’,
The sound of toothache's body hitting and the sound of sharp knives breaking flesh filled the air.
Lingxi frowned in the distance and turned her pretty face to the side;
‘It’s such a low-level fight, it hurts to see it. ’
Sang Kuimu was hit in one leg by a chain of kicks, and two of his teeth at the end were shattered.
He staggered and fell to the ground, covering his mouth and spitting out his bloody broken teeth, feeling the hatred in his heart.
He has been domineering in Meigu Town since he was a child. When has he ever suffered such a blow?
A year ago, he could have stabbed this kid to death with one finger.
He glared at the little monk who had been stabbed in the thigh, feeling angry in his heart;
'Five cuts with the mulberry knife, rolling knife, little bastard, death,'
A donkey rolled from the ground to Yunyang,
Yunyang was stabbed during the attack.
Now blood is gushing out from the knife edge,
The injury caused by the master hurt so deeply that I felt cold in my heart.
But when he saw the sword light coming at him quickly, he ignored the pain and twisted with one palm on the ground;
‘Lingyan escaped and returned with the knife. ’
The body flips around in the void with unimaginable agility,
The palm knife cuts across Sangkuimu's Adam's apple,
‘Pfft’, ‘Ahhh’
Two screams came,
